Pager.$why: The pager hugs "1 of 2", whose width follows the font (Figma's Inter draws "1" 7 px wide at 13 px, the web font 5.33 px); the height and the 2 px gap are compared.

Question.$why: Figma's Question is an auto-layout frame around one text; the code's heading is a block, so it has no gap.

Tile 1.$why: Figma draws the tiles 140 px wide, each hugging its caption; in code the three share the row (flex), so they are about 144 px and follow the card's width.
